ABOUT.TEXT: Hey there, I'm Anne! After working in conservation and recruiting, I discovered my passion for software development and the unique combination of creativity and logic it offers. I am currently training as a Fullstack Developer while building my own projects to strengthen my skills in frontend, backend, and AI-powered applications.
ABOUT.P1: Currently based in Göttingen, Lower Saxony, and open to remote and hybrid opportunities
ABOUT.P2: I am curious, open-minded, and committed to continuously expanding my skills and growing as a developer.
ABOUT.P3: Combining a solution-oriented mindset with reliability and independent work, I enjoy taking on challenges and finding effective solutions.

SKILLS.P1: My technical journey focuses on fullstack web development, combining creative frontend solutions with structured backend development. I am especially interested in the possibilities of AI and automation to enhance development processes and create innovative solutions.
SKILLS.P3: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.

PROJECTS.P: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

REF.H: What my colleagues say about me

CONTACT.P1: I enjoy connecting with people, exploring new ideas, and finding creative solutions to interesting challenges. If you have a project, an opportunity, or a question, feel free to reach out — I would be happy to start a conversation.
